The '''1961–62 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 26th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 9 September 1961 and ended on 1 July 1962 with the play-off matches. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their sixth Greek title and third consecutive.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
